newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico February open unemployment 4.2 pct - INEGI.
newsitem.headline: Mexico February open unemployment 4.2 pct - INEGI.

text.p: Mexico's National Statistics Institute said Wednesday that the open unemployment rate during February was 4.2 percent, down from 6.3 percent in February last year.

Mexico's open unemployment rate is the base level of joblessness in the country. It is the proportion of economically active population who are 12 years old or more who in the reference period did not work more than one hour per week, although they were looking for work.
The institute, known in Mexico by its acronym INEGI, said the metropolitan areas that registered the lowest indices of unemployment were Leon, Acapulco, Morelia, Ciudad del Carmen and Ciudad Juarez.
In January this year, open unemployment was 4.5 percent, INEGI added. "The open unemployment rate continues to come down," the agency said.

INEGI said that of those working in February, 26.5 percent were employed in industry, 21.5 percent in commerce, and 38.5 percent in services. Those three sectors made up 86.5 percent of the active workforce.
